jun: FYI ran int4 onboarding for aurora13b with the new remap+rotary folded path. seeing reproducible token collisions and longctx repetition.

tanya: can you share the conversion command?

jun: python -m redwood.onboard --model aurora13b --out aurora-int4 --quant lut-int4 --rotary folded --remap auto-v4.json --normalize NFKD

adrien: NFKD before remap? that order can create combining-mark variants mapping to same id.

jun: yep, pipeline did normalize after remap (bug). small repro: e+acute (0x65 0xcc 0x81) and U+1F600 emoji both remapped to id 40211 due to heuristic. causes kv reuse + rotary misalignment -> repeating fragments around 2500 tokens.

tanya: metrics?

jun: baseline fp16 rougeL=0.43 ppx=17.5, converted rougeL=0.30 ppx=29.1. embedding cosine drop ~0.09.

adrien: quick mitigation: force legacy rotary scale (scale=1.0) for aurora until we fix remap ordering and add collision checks.

ml-ci-bot: onboard-job-1755559999 started: aurora13b -> aurora-int4 (job_id=onb-5517)

jun: added small unix script that tokenizes before/after remap to show collisions; attaching to ticket.

tanya: plan: 1) flip normalize-before-remap in pipeline, 2) add remap unit-test to detect same id for distinct unicode sequences, 3) add headwise post-attn normalize when folded rotary is enabled.

adrien: I'll open kernel PR to ensure folded-int4 path preserves per-head scale invariants.

jun: scheduling longctx CI run across aurora/gemma/qwen after PRs.

ml-ci-bot: scheduled longctx-regression-suite (run_id=lr-175555)

tanya: great. please paste short write-up in #eng-ml when done so onboarding checklist can be updated. closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
